note: The traveller's real 10-day Japan plan (plan.txt) as Gemini read it on 2026-09-29, frozen so the pin check places the same stops every time.

items.title: Train from Kansai International Airport to Kyoto Station
Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyo-ji
items.detail: Check in. Straight to bed — no late-night food mission.
items.place: Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyo-ji

items.title: SANGA ONO KYOTO JOKYO-JI
items.detail: Breakfast only. NO morning Buddhist/temple service.

items.title: Fushimi Inari Taisha
items.detail: Continue uphill beyond the main crowds. Yotsutsuji Viewpoint = turnaround point. Food radar: Inari sushi, Kitsune udon. · Inside: Rōmon Gate, Honden / Main Shrine, Senbon Torii, Okusha / Inner Shrine

items.title: Shinkyogoku Shopping Street
items.detail: Stationery, stickers/notebooks, gachapon, character merchandise, weird/cute Japanese souvenirs.

items.title: Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyo-ji
items.place: Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyo-ji

items.title: Gion
items.detail: Shopping radar: Furoshiki, Incense, Wagashi, Kyoto tea, Japanese paper, Traditional crafts. · Inside: Gion Shirakawa

items.title: Arashiyama streets
items.detail: Snack radar: Matcha soft serve, Hojicha soft serve, Dango, Yatsuhashi, Seasonal wagashi, % Arabica only if the queue is reasonable. Shopping: Bamboo crafts, chopsticks, tenugui, ceramics, traditional sweets.

items.title: Pontochō Alley
items.detail: Lanterns + traditional alley. Glance toward Kamo River / Kiyamachi.

items.title: Kiyomizu-dera
items.detail: Higashiyama snack radar: Nama-yatsuhashi, Mitarashi dango, Warabi mochi, Matcha/hojicha sweets, Senbei. Shopping: Ceramics, chopsticks, furoshiki, incense, fans, Japanese paper. · Inside: Main Hall, Otowa Waterfall

items.title: Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyo-ji
items.place: Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyo-ji

items.title: Train from Kyoto Station to Shin-Osaka Station
items.detail: Shinkansen departure. Transfer onward at Shin-Osaka at 15:00.

items.title: Dotonbori
items.detail: Optional food radar: Takoyaki Wanaka, Juhachiban, 551 Horai butaman, Takosen. · Inside: Dotonbori Canal

items.title: Excelsior Caffé Shinsaibashi
items.detail: CREMIA 🍦. Optional if you're too full.

items.title: Kuromon Ichiba Market
items.detail: Light scouting/grazing only because returning Oct 8. Maguro, Tamagoyaki, Scallop, Fruit.

items.title: Sennichimae Doguyasuji
items.detail: Kitchenware paradise: Japanese knives, chopsticks, ceramics, bento supplies, takoyaki equipment, tiny kitchen gadgets, plastic food models.

items.title: KAWACHI Artist Materials
items.detail: Stationery mission: Pilot, Uni, Zebra, Pentel, Sakura, Tombow, brush pens, mechanical pencils, Japanese notebooks, erasers, washi tape.

items.title: Rikuro's Cheesecake
items.detail: Osaka jiggly cheesecake. This is today's dessert.

items.title: SUSHIDOKORO AMANO
items.detail: Sushi omakase. No post-dinner food mission.

items.title: Osaka Castle
items.detail: Main keep, historical exhibits, upper-level city view.

items.title: Kyobashi
items.detail: Old-school Osaka neighborhood, narrow restaurant streets, standing bars, retro signs.

items.title: Izakaya Toyo lunch
items.detail: TUNA CHEEK / maguro hoho-niku, maguro sashimi, aburi / torch-seared tuna, fatty tuna if available.

items.title: DEEP OSAKA FOOD TOUR
items.detail: Meeting point: Dobutsuen-mae Station, top of the stairs at Exit 1. Tour handles dinner.

items.title: Train from Shin-Osaka Station to Hiroshima Station
Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park
items.detail: Inside: Cenotaph, Flame of Peace, Children's Peace Monument

items.title: Ferry from Motoyasubashi Pier to Miyajima Pier
KAKIYA
items.detail: Oyster lunch. Targets: Yaki-kaki (grilled oysters), Kaki furai (fried oysters), Kaki meshi (oyster rice). · Getting there: Arrival at Miyajima Pier, 12:35

items.title: Miyajima Omotesando Shopping Street
items.detail: Food: Momiji manju, Age-momiji, Anago, Oysters. Souvenirs: Shamoji / rice paddles, Momiji items, Deer goods, Packaged momiji manju.

items.title: Daishō-in
items.detail: Temple complex, stone statues, small Buddhist figures, mountain atmosphere.

items.title: Ferry from Miyajima Pier to Motoyasubashi Pier
Hiroshima Yume Plaza
items.detail: Hiroshima regional foods, sauces, sweets, local souvenirs.

items.title: Train from Hiroshima Station to Shin-Osaka Station
Kuromon Ichiba Market
items.detail: Proper eating visit. Food radar: Akami, Chūtoro, Ōtoro, Grilled scallop, Oyster, Dashimaki tamago, Wagyu skewer, Yakiimo.

items.title: Shitennō-ji
items.detail: Temple gates, Central precinct, Five-story pagoda.

items.title: Shinsekai
items.detail: Retro Osaka, neon/signage, Billiken, giant restaurant signs.

items.title: Yaekatsu
items.detail: Yaekatsu or Daruma. Only a couple: shrimp, lotus root, asparagus, quail egg.

items.title: Den Den Town
items.detail: Electronics, retro games, anime/manga, character goods, gachapon, tiny figures.

items.title: mookEN
items.detail: Petit cream puffs / dessert. Try if available; don't wreck the schedule for it.

items.title: IKEMAN SEMBA
items.detail: Pens, mechanical pencils, notebooks, stickers, office supplies.

items.title: Train from Osaka Station to Himeji Station
Himeji Castle
items.detail: Main keep, defensive gates/passages, white plaster walls, castle interior, elevated views, classic frontal castle photo.

items.title: Kōko-en Garden
items.detail: Traditional gardens, ponds, bridges, tea-garden landscapes, castle views.

items.title: Train from Himeji Station to Sannomiya Station
Rōshōki
items.detail: Butaman / small steamed pork buns. Don't sacrifice the afternoon if the queue is insane.

items.title: Nankinmachi
items.detail: Paifang gates, lanterns, Chinese-Japanese food stalls. Other snack radar: Goma dango, Annin tofu, Xiaolongbao, Chinese pastries.

items.title: Meriken Park
items.detail: Kobe Port Tower, BE KOBE sign, harbor views.

items.title: Kobe Harborland
items.detail: Mosaic, harbor lights, night waterfront, Port Tower views.

items.title: Train from Sannomiya Station to Osaka Station
Osaka Station City
items.detail: Station architecture, elevated walkways, department stores, food halls. Final food radar: Ikayaki, 551 butaman, Taiyaki, Wagashi, Sushi/tempura. Depachika souvenir radar: Tea, Senbei, Furikake, Japanese spices, Wagashi, Cookies, Boxed sweets.

items.title: Nakanoshima Park
items.detail: Riverside walk, bridges, architecture, final relaxed Osaka stroll.

items.title: Flight KIX to Vancouver
items.detail: Flight departure. · Getting there: Train from Osaka Station to Kansai International Airport, 15:30
